commands: git status --porcelain; echo "---ENV---"; echo "run_id=${GITHUB_RUN_ID:-none} attempt=${GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT:-none} actions=${GITHUB_ACTIONS:-none}"

mkdir -p .prflow/tmp
if rm -f ".prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before" ".prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-disabled" 2>/dev/null &&
   git status --porcelain -z > ".prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before" &&
   [ -f ".prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before" ] &&
   [ ! -L ".prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before" ] &&
   git hash-object ".prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before"; then
  echo "snapshot-ok"
else
  echo "::warning::devflow review: could not create snapshot; dirty-tree backstop DISABLED" >&2
  rm -f ". …[per-command-truncated]

for f in skills/implement/phases/phase-2-implement.md skills/implement/phases/phase-2-sweeps-contract.md skills/implement/phases/phase-2-sweeps-quality.md; do echo "=== $f ==="; git show a59a4107511027024791aaeb51ea658241ee2ea6:$f | grep -n "status Planning\|status Implementing\|--tick-plan\|--status" ; done

for f in skills/implement/SKILL.md skills/implement/phases/phase-2-implement.md skills/implement/phases/phase-2-sweeps-contract.md skills/implement/phases/phase-2-sweeps-quality.md; do echo "=== $f ==="; git show a59a4107511027024791aaeb51ea658241ee2ea6:$f | grep -nE "tick-plan|status Planning|status Implementing|status Discovering" ; done

for f in skills/implement/SKILL.md skills/implement/phases/phase-2-implement.md skills/implement/phases/phase-2-sweeps-contract.md skills/implement/phases/phase-2-sweeps-quality.md skills/implement/phases/phase-2-sweeps-quality.md; do echo "=== $f ==="; git show a59a4107511027024791aaeb51ea658241ee2ea6:"$f" | grep -nE "tick-plan|status Planning|status Implementing|status Discovering"; done

cd /home/runner/work/prflow/prflow; total=0; for f in skills/implement/SKILL.md skills/implement/phases/phase-2-implement.md skills/implement/phases/phase-2-sweeps-contract.md skills/implement/phases/phase-2-sweeps-quality.md; do b=$(git show a59a4107511027024791aaeb51ea658241ee2ea6:"$f" | wc -c); a=$(git show 1d4e7c30c1efd18b1e358713775055fe6b814820:"$f" | wc -c); d=$((b-a)); echo "$f: $d"; total=$((total+d)); done; echo "TOTAL DELTA: $total"

scrub.shapes: GitHub tokens/PATs, Anthropic keys, Bearer Authorization headers, and basic Authorization headers
